name: Assassin
summary: A killer for hire who strikes before the fight begins.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

features.name: Assassinate
features.short: Advantage against creatures that haven't acted; surprise hits crit.
features.summary: You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. Any hit you score against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.short: Spend a week and 25 gp to build a false identity.
features.summary: You can spend seven days and 25 gp to establish a false identity with documentation, acquaintances and disguises.

features.name: Impostor
features.short: Mimic someone's speech, writing and behavior.
features.summary: After studying a person's speech, handwriting and behavior for at least 3 hours, you can unerringly mimic them; casual observers can't see through it, and wary ones check against your Deception with disadvantage.

features.name: Death Strike
features.short: Surprised targets take double damage (CON save).
features.summary: When you attack and hit a surprised creature, it must make a CON save (DC 8 + DEX + PB). On a failure, double the damage of your attack.
